# Anointed — Analytics Specification

**Generated by:** Data / Analytics Agent  
**Source documents:** `requirements.json`, `design-spec.md`  
**Date:** 1 Sep 2026  
**Platform:** Flutter mobile (iOS 15+ / Android 8.0+) + Web Admin Dashboard (FastAPI + React)

> **Compliance note:** This app collects data from children under 13. Any analytics framework and data pipeline must be configured for **non-personalized, COPPA/DPDPA-compliant** data collection for under-13 users. This means no cross-app tracking, no advertising identifiers (IDFA/GAID) for under-13, and no behavioral profiling for ad targeting. All events tagged 🛡 require extra care in under-13 contexts.

## 1. Analytics Stack Recommendation

| Component | Choice | Rationale |
|-----------|--------|-----------|
| Primary event ingestion | **Firebase Analytics** (optional — already assumed for Crashlytics) | Free tier is sufficient for 100–500 users in year 1; Flutter SDK is first-class; integrates with BigQuery for future BI export |
| Custom event store | **`AnalyticsEvent` table in NeonDB** (PostgreSQL) | Required regardless — admin reports query it directly; provides full operator control without vendor lock-in |
| Crash reporting | Firebase Crashlytics | Already selected in `techStack.crashReporting` |
| Ad impression data | AdMob SDK logs | Available in AdMob dashboard; also log to `AdImpressionLog` backend entity for admin reporting |
| BI / export | Admin dashboard CSV export from NeonDB | `analytics.reporting` specifies internal dashboard + CSV export; PDF deferred to post-v1 |

**Minimum viable:** The `AnalyticsEvent` table alone satisfies all reporting requirements for v1 at the stated scale. Firebase Analytics is additive and optional; include it if the team wants the Firebase console for real-time debugging.

---

## 2. Common Event Envelope

Every event — mobile or admin — is stored with this base payload. Client-side fields are sent in the API call body; server-side fields are stamped by the backend.

```json
{
  "event_name":    "string — snake_case event identifier",
  "timestamp_utc": "ISO 8601 — server-stamped at receipt",
  "session_id":    "UUID — generated on app open, rotated after 30 min inactivity",
  "user_id":       "UUID — server-side user identifier (never mobile number in events)",
  "age_group":     "kid | youth | adult | elder",
  "is_under_13":   "boolean 🛡 — controls data processing rules downstream",
  "platform":      "ios | android | web_admin",
  "app_version":   "semver string e.g. 1.0.0",
  "os_version":    "string",
  "device_type":   "phone | tablet",
  "properties":    "object — event-specific fields (see each event below)"
}
```

> **Privacy guardrail:** `user_id` must be an opaque internal UUID. Mobile number, name, and any PII must never appear in the analytics event stream. On account deletion, `user_id` in `AnalyticsEvent` rows is nullified (not deleted — the aggregate counts remain valid) per the hard-delete policy.

## 3. Mobile App Events — Session & App Lifecycle

### `session_start`
Fired on every cold launch or foreground resume after 30 min inactivity.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `is_new_user` | boolean | `true` on first-ever launch before sign-up completes |
| `launch_source` | `cold_launch \| foreground_resume` | Distinguish retention (resume) from installs (cold) |
| `auth_provider_linked` | `google \| apple \| phone \| none` | Whether user has linked an auth provider at session time |
| `account_status` | `pending_parental_consent \| consented \| null` | 🛡 Null for pre-sign-up; pending blocks gameplay/ad analytics |
| `connectivity` | `online \| offline` | Captures practice-mode session patterns |

---

### `screen_view`
Fired on every screen transition. Standard Flutter navigation observer hook.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `screen_name` | string | Matches screen IDs from design-spec.md (e.g. `M-11_level_map`, `M-13_gameplay`) |
| `previous_screen` | string \| null | Enables funnel path analysis |
| `time_on_previous_screen_ms` | integer | Duration on the previous screen in milliseconds |

---

### `force_upgrade_shown`
Fired when app version is below minimum and M-02 is displayed.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `installed_version` | string | The user's current version |
| `minimum_version` | string | The version returned by the API |

## 4. Mobile App Events — Authentication, Onboarding & VPC

> **Pending-consent guardrail 🛡:** For users in `pending_parental_consent`, the client must **not** emit gameplay, ad, leaderboard, or purchase events. Only onboarding/VPC events (this section) and `screen_view` for VPC screens are permitted until `account_status = consented`.

### `sign_up_started`
Fired when user taps any sign-up CTA on Welcome screen M-03.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `auth_method` | `google \| apple \| phone` | Which path the user chose |

---

### `sign_up_completed`
Fired after account is fully activated and user reaches the level map for the first time.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `auth_method` | `google \| apple \| phone` | Sign-up path used |
| `age_group` | string | kid / youth / adult / elder |
| `parental_consent_required` | boolean 🛡 | Whether under-13 VPC flow was triggered |
| `parental_consent_method` | `oauth_parent_attestation \| email_plus_confirmation \| null` 🛡 | VPC method used; null if age ≥ 13 |
| `parental_consent_granted` | boolean 🛡 | Whether VPC completed successfully |
| `onboarding_duration_ms` | integer | Total time from `sign_up_started` to account activated |

---

| `routed_to_vpc` | boolean | Always `true` when this event fires |

## 5. Mobile App Events — Gameplay

### `level_started`
Fired when user taps "Play" on M-12 (level detail card) and the first question loads.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `level_id` | integer | 1–100 |
| `difficulty_tier` | string | Configured per level in admin A-07 |
| `timer_seconds` | integer | Starting timer for this level |
| `attempt_number` | integer | 1 = first try; increments per `level_restarted` within session |
| `is_practice_mode` | boolean | `false` here; `true` in practice-mode events §6 |

---

### `question_answered`
Fired on every answer submission during a level.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `level_id` | integer | |
| `question_index` | integer | 0-based position in the 10-question set |
| `question_type` | `text_qa \| image_clue \| verse_clue` | Variant type from §18H |
| `is_correct` | boolean | |
| `time_taken_ms` | integer | Time from question display to answer tap — **key ML hook** |
| `timer_remaining_ms` | integer | Timer snapshot at answer time — **key ML hook** |
| `attempt_number` | integer | Current level attempt number |

---

### `timer_expired`
Fired when countdown hits zero on M-16.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `level_id` | integer | |
| `question_index` | integer | Which question the timer expired on |
| `attempt_number` | integer | |

---

### `level_failed`
Fired when a wrong answer ends the current attempt (M-15 shown).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `level_id` | integer | |
| `fail_reason` | `wrong_answer \| timer_expired` | |
| `question_index_at_fail` | integer | Which question triggered the fail |
| `attempt_number` | integer | |
| `time_elapsed_ms` | integer | Time spent in the attempt before failing |

---

### `level_restarted`
Fired when user taps "Try again" on M-15 or M-16.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `level_id` | integer | |
| `attempt_number` | integer | The new attempt number (= previous + 1) |
| `fail_reason` | `wrong_answer \| timer_expired` | Why the previous attempt ended |

---

### `level_completed`
Fired when user answers all 10 questions correctly (M-14 shown).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `level_id` | integer | |
| `attempts_taken` | integer | Total attempts before this pass |
| `completion_time_ms` | integer | Duration of the successful attempt |
| `timer_remaining_ms` | integer | Timer value when last question was answered |
| `first_try_pass` | boolean | `attempts_taken == 1` — key difficulty calibration signal |
| `next_level_locked` | boolean | Whether level+1 requires IAP — triggers IAP prompt if true |

## 6A. Mobile App Events — Content Cache Sync

> Source: design-spec.md §19. Tracks practice pack freshness. Main mode is always server-authoritative and does not use these events for question delivery.

### `content_manifest_checked`
Fired after `GET /v1/content/manifest` on online cold launch or M-18 entry (if >24h since last check).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `server_content_version` | integer | Version returned by manifest |
| `local_content_version` | integer | Version on device before check |
| `update_needed` | boolean | `server > local` |

---

### `content_cache_updated`
Fired after practice pack download, checksum verification, and atomic swap succeed.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `from_version` | integer | Previous local version |
| `to_version` | integer | New local version |
| `download_size_bytes` | integer | Pack size |
| `duration_ms` | integer | Download + verify + swap time |

---

### `content_cache_update_failed`
Fired when pack download or checksum verification fails.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `local_content_version` | integer | Unchanged local version |
| `attempted_version` | integer | Server version that failed to apply |
| `error_code` | `network \| checksum_mismatch \| disk_full \| corrupt_pack` | Failure reason |

## 8. Mobile App Events — Ads

> **Under-13 constraint 🛡:** Users where `is_under_13 = true` never see ads — M-21 is skipped, ad SDK not initialized, no `ad_viewed` / `ad_clicked` events.

> **13+ frequency cap (§20):** Log `ad_eligible` boolean on level complete; only fire `ad_viewed` when M-21 actually displays (every 3rd level complete, max 2/session, skip levels 1–3).

### `ad_viewed`
Fired when an ad unit completes its impression (AdMob callback: `onAdImpression`).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `ad_unit_id` | string | AdMob ad unit identifier |
| `ad_format` | `banner \| interstitial \| rewarded` | v1 uses interstitial on M-21 after level complete |
| `ad_personalized` | boolean 🛡 | `false` for under-13 users; `true` for others (where opted in) |
| `placement` | string | Screen context (e.g. `M-21_ad_break`, `level_complete_M-14`) |

---

### `ad_clicked`
Fired when user taps an ad (AdMob callback: `onAdClicked`).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `ad_unit_id` | string | |
| `ad_format` | string | |
| `ad_personalized` | boolean 🛡 | |
| `placement` | string | |

---

## 12. Push Notification Events

**Remote push (FCM/APNs):** Not in v1 — no server-side notification infrastructure.

**Local notifications:** See §9A — on-device reminders via `flutter_local_notifications`; no FCM/APNs gateway required.

When **remote push** is added post-v1, instrument:

| Future Event | Trigger |
|---|---|
| `notification_sent` | Backend sends push (server-side) |
| `notification_delivered` | FCM/APNs delivery receipt received |
| `notification_opened` | User taps notification and app opens |
| `notification_opted_out` | User disables notifications in Settings or OS |

Each notification event must carry `notification_type` and `notification_campaign_id` fields to measure effectiveness per message category.

---

## 13. Personalization / ML Data Hooks

`analytics.personalization`: *"Adaptive difficulty — adjust question difficulty and timer pressure based on user performance history within age-appropriate bounds."*

The adaptive difficulty system requires per-user, per-question performance signals. The events above already capture what is needed. This section specifies how they must be aggregated.

### Data to Capture (already in events above)

| Signal | Source Event | Field |
|--------|-------------|-------|
| Per-question response time | `question_answered` | `time_taken_ms` |
| Timer utilization ratio | `question_answered` | `timer_remaining_ms / timer_seconds` |
| Per-question correctness | `question_answered` | `is_correct` |
| Level attempts before pass | `level_completed` | `attempts_taken` |
| First-try pass rate | `level_completed` | `first_try_pass` |
| Timer expiry frequency | `timer_expired` | count per user per difficulty tier |
| Fail point (which question) | `level_failed` | `question_index_at_fail` |
| Practice vs. main-mode behavior | `practice_level_*` vs. `level_*` | count comparison |
| Age group | All events | `age_group` |

### Backend Table: `user_performance_summary`

For the ML/adaptive system to be queryable without scanning all raw events, the backend should maintain a rolling summary table:

```sql
user_performance_summary (
  user_id         UUID,
  level_id        INTEGER,
  age_group       TEXT,
  attempts_total  INTEGER,
  pass_count      INTEGER,
  avg_time_per_question_ms  INTEGER,
  avg_timer_utilization     FLOAT,  -- 0.0 = used all time; 1.0 = answered instantly
  first_try_pass_rate       FLOAT,
  last_updated    TIMESTAMPTZ
)
```

This table is updated asynchronously after each `level_completed` or `level_failed` event and is the primary input to the future adaptive difficulty engine.

### Age-Appropriate Bounds

Per `analytics.personalization`, difficulty adjustments must respect age groups:
- `kid` (6–12): difficulty progression must be gentler; timer floors must never be below a developmentally appropriate minimum (suggest 20s minimum regardless of adaptive model output).
- `elder`: reduce timer pressure aggressively on first 3 failed attempts.
- `youth` / `adult`: standard adaptive curve.

The `age_group` field on every event is the discriminator for enforcing these bounds.

## 14. Reporting Needs & Backend Implications

`analytics.reporting`: *"Internal web admin dashboard for operator with exportable reports (CSV/PDF); track DAU, level funnel, IAP conversion, ad impressions, and leaderboard engagement."*

### Reports Required (v1)

| Report | Metric | Driving Events | Admin Screen |
|--------|--------|---------------|--------------|
| **DAU trend** | Unique `user_id` per calendar day (UTC) | `session_start` | A-10 |
| **Level funnel** | `level_started` → `level_failed` → `level_restarted` → `level_completed` counts per level | `level_started`, `level_failed`, `level_completed` | A-10 |
| **VPC funnel** 🛡 | `vpc_parent_gate_viewed` → `vpc_path_selected` → `parental_consent_completed` → `sign_up_completed` (under-13) | VPC events §4 | A-10 |
| **IAP conversion funnel** | `iap_prompt_shown` → `purchase_initiated` → `purchase_completed` rates | `iap_prompt_shown`, `purchase_initiated`, `purchase_completed`, `purchase_cancelled`, `purchase_failed` | A-10 |
| **Ad impressions** | Impression and click counts by placement and date | `ad_viewed`, `ad_clicked` | A-10 |
| **Leaderboard engagement** | `leaderboard_viewed` and `leaderboard_submitted` counts; deferred-sync rate | `leaderboard_viewed`, `leaderboard_submitted` | A-10 |

### Backend Implications

1. **`AnalyticsEvent` table indexes:** Add indexes on `(event_name, timestamp_utc)` and `(user_id, event_name)` for efficient report queries at the stated scale (100–500 users × ~100 events/session est.).

2. **Date boundary handling:** DAU and leaderboard reports must partition by UTC date and display with timezone label per `backend.timezoneHandling`. The API should return timestamps in UTC; the admin dashboard converts to local display.

3. **Export endpoint:** `GET /admin/reports/{report_type}/export?start=&end=&format=csv` — returns a CSV stream. This endpoint must be admin-authed and logged via `admin_report_exported`.

4. **`user_performance_summary` table:** Required for adaptive difficulty (§13). Populate asynchronously — do not block level-complete response on its update.

5. **`AdImpressionLog` entity:** Already listed in `backend.entities`. This is separate from `AnalyticsEvent` to comply with AdMob's logging requirements and allow ad-network reconciliation. Mirror `ad_viewed` / `ad_clicked` events to both tables.

6. **PDF report export:** Deferred to post-v1 per design-spec.md inference IA-10. CSV export covers all v1 reporting needs.

7. **Event volume estimate:** At 100–500 DAU, with ~50–100 events per active session, expect 5,000–50,000 events/day. NeonDB free tier handles this comfortably; no partitioning needed for year 1.

## 15. Implementation Notes

### Flutter Client

- Use a thin `AnalyticsService` singleton that batches events and flushes on network availability — required for offline practice-mode sessions where events queue locally and sync when internet is restored.
- The `session_id` must be generated on app open and passed on every event, including offline-queued events.
- **Never log PII** (mobile number, name) in event `properties`. Only internal UUIDs.

### Under-13 Data Handling 🛡

- All events for users where `is_under_13 = true` must be stored in a compliant manner: no advertising identifiers, no cross-app profiling linkage.
- Users in `pending_parental_consent` must emit **only** VPC/onboarding events (§4) and `screen_view` for VPC screens — no gameplay, ad, purchase, or leaderboard events until consent is verified.
- AdMob: call `MobileAds.instance.updateRequestConfiguration(RequestConfiguration(tagForChildDirectedTreatment: TagForChildDirectedTreatment.yes))` before initializing ad units for under-13 users.
- Firebase Analytics (if used): call `FirebaseAnalytics.instance.setConsent(...)` appropriately for under-13 users.

### Account Deletion

- On hard delete, `user_id` in `AnalyticsEvent` rows must be nullified (set to NULL), not deleted. This preserves aggregate counts (level funnel totals, DAU counts) while removing the link to a specific person.
- The `admin_user_deleted` event itself is retained in the audit log (`admin_user_deleted` events in `AnalyticsEvent` are excluded from the nullification sweep — they are compliance records, not personal data).

### Admin Dashboard Audit Events

- Admin events (§11) must be written synchronously and transactionally with the action they log. An admin deletion that fails to write its audit event must roll back.
- The A-12 Audit Log Viewer queries `AnalyticsEvent WHERE platform = 'web_admin'` filtered by `event_name` for the relevant admin action types.
